item.title: This decade has been missing its big-impact midterm
item.description: Every other decade over the past hundred years has produced at least one midterm that made a big difference in Congress and in national politics more...

item.title: Severe flooding hits Four Corners region, more expected through the weekend
item.description: Intense rainfall slammed the Four Corners region late this week. As rivers flooded, towns declared evacuations and emergencies and made rescues.

item.title: U.S. birth rate hits record low as older women have more babies
item.description: A CDC report shows the U.S. birth rate has fallen to its lowest level on record, though older women are having more children.

item.title: Medicare Advantage plan ending next year? What to know
item.description: Medicare open enrollment runs through Dec. 7, and up to 5 million seniors may need to log on and choose a new plan.
